To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the proposed network integrity methods can be useful in identifying therapeutic targets for cancer treatment.

1) the identification of therapeutic target genes based on network analysis is possible and can be facilitated by the use of network integrity methods that consider the centrality of nodes within a biological network; 2) the use of different network representations can lead to different conclusions about the importance of nodes and thus the identification of potential therapeutic targets; and 3) the identification of optimal cancer therapeutic targets based on a network analysis is possible.

(i) network centrality statistics can be used to identify genes that are optimal targets for therapeutic intervention; (ii) the centrality of a gene depends on the network representation; (iii) centrality of a node in a network depends on the network topology; and (iv) the centrality statistics are consistent with biological knowledge.
In summary, our research is concerned with
identifying optimal therapeutic targets based on an analysis that considers the centrality of nodes in a biological network, and the origins of the network topology.
the identification of optimal targets for therapeutic interventions in a biological network.
the development of network-based methods that can be used to identify optimal targets for therapeutic interventions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the network analysis methods proposed in this work can be used to identify therapeutic targets that are optimal in a network sense, and can be used to suggest the optimal targets for therapeutic interventions in cancer and other diseases.
the proposed methods can be used to identify therapeutic targets in a disease network and that the results of such analyses are useful in guiding therapeutic interventions.

our proposed methodology can be used to identify candidate therapeutic targets that may have a significant impact on the functioning of a disease-related network or pathway and thus, potentially, on the course of that disease.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed methods can be used to identify optimal cancer therapeutic targets based on a biological gene network analysis.
the centrality statistics of the nodes of a network, in particular the centrality statistics that consider the origins of that topology, may be useful in identifying optimal therapeutic targets.

the identification of a gene or genes that are optimal therapeutic targets is a function of their importance within a gene expression network, the network topology, the centrality measures used, and the origin of the topology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the identification of therapeutic cancer targets is a network problem, and the use of network integrity methods is essential to this problem.
the identification of cancer therapeutic targets based on an analysis and characterization of the biological gene network involved in a disease is possible.
network topology and centrality statistics are useful tools for identifying optimal therapeutic targets.
